maxSpreadAbsolute.description:
The absolute term of the accepted deviation, always in units of `10^-8` — a FIXED reference
scale, rescaled to each submission's own normalisation scale before use, so the setting's
real-world meaning does not move with the `decimals` the enclaves happen to pick. To ask for
a real-world tolerance `T` in the feed's own units, set `T * 1e8`. As a decimal string; at
most 2^64 - 1. Zero gives a purely relative bound; a non-zero value is what keeps the bound
usable for a feed hovering at or near zero, where the relative term alone collapses to zero.
With both terms zero the rule is parity-split: at an ODD count the two values at the median
position may differ by one unit of the batch's scale, because the spread halves and floors;
at an EVEN count the spread is the raw gap, so they must match exactly. Values outside the
bracketing pair (they first exist at an even count of 4 or an odd count of 5) never enter
the rejection spread — the flagging still judges them: every machine further than the bound
from the median is named. Two traps the contract cannot check, because the scale is the
enclaves' choice and is only known per batch: the rescale FLOORS, so a value below one unit
of the batch's own scale (`< 10^(8 - decimals)`) silently becomes zero; and at a batch
the bound goes inert as soon as the RESCALED value reaches the largest reachable deviation
(~4.3e17), i.e. when `maxSpreadAbsolute * 10^(decimals - 8) >= 4.3e17` — which a `T = 1`
setting hits at `decimals >= 18` — disabling the rejection and the flagging alike;
`decimals >= 29` additionally short-circuits straight to that clamp for any non-zero value.
Pin the enclave's `decimals` per feed and size against it.

maxSpreadBIPS.description:
The relative term of the accepted deviation between the contributed values, in BIPS of
`abs(median)`. The deviation bound is
`allowed = maxSpreadAbsolute (rescaled) + maxSpreadBIPS * abs(median) / 10000`, and a
submission is rejected on the spread AT the median position — not on `max - min`: for four or
more signatures the tails are excluded from this test, still evaluated by the flagging
check, and named in `FeedOutliers` only when their deviation exceeds the bound. That spread
is the gap between the two bracketing values for an EVEN count,
and HALF of it for an ODD one, so a raw bracketing gap of up to `2 * allowed + 1` still
lands at an odd count. Note the two tests use
`allowed` with different metrics and neither dominates the other: at an EVEN count rejection
bites at half the per-machine displacement flagging does, while at an ODD count the judged
spread is the MEAN of the two gaps flanking the median and so bites up to 2x LATER than
flagging — which is why an accepted batch can name an outlier from N = 3 on. Size this from
the rejection side for liveness, but do not read either test as implying the other. Must be at most 10000 (100%). 100 (1%) matches FAssets' live flare configuration.

registryName.description: The registry name for this feed's TeeOracleFeedStore instance (e.g. "UsdxFeedStore").

requiredSignatures.description:
The number of distinct PRODUCTION TEE machine signatures one feed-update submission must
carry, each over that machine's own observation at the same INSTANT — one shared `observedAt`;
responses to different requests emitted in the same block share it and may be combined; the
store stores the
median of them. Must be in [1, 32]. A fresh deployment uses 1 — the fleet must actually
have this many PRODUCTION machines running the feed's latest published configuration, which
nothing on chain can check, so raise it with the governance `setSubmissionPolicy` setter
once it does.

sourceConfigs.description: Per-source id configuration (source id + fee schedule limits).

maxFeeDelaySeconds.description: Maximum delay (in seconds) allowed in a fee schedule entry for this source.

maxFeeSchedules.description: Maximum number of (factor, delay) pairs allowed in a fee schedule for this source.

anchorReuseDelaySeconds.description: Anchor reuse delay in seconds (how long after a batch closes before an anchor can be reused).

addAfterNotChilledEpochs.description: Number of last consecutive epochs in which data provider should not be chilled in order to be accepted to the management group.

addAfterRewardedEpochs.description: Number of last epochs with initialised rewards in which data provider needs to earn rewards in order to be accepted to the management group.

decimalsUpdateOffset.description: Feed decimals update timelock measured in reward epochs (must be more than 1, e.g. 3).

defaultFeeWei.description: The default fee for fetching fast update feeds. In Wei.

deployerPrivateKey.description: Deployer private key. Overriden if provided in `.env` file as `DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY`

fdc2DefaultNumberOfTees.description: The default number of TEEs used in FDC2.

fdc2InflationConfigurations.description: The inflation configurations for the FDC2 protocol.

fdc2MinThresholdBIPS.description: The minimal threshold for FDC2 in BIPS (e.g. 30%).

fdc2RequestFees.description: The supported FDC2 requests fee configurations.

fdcInflationConfigurations.description: The inflation configurations for the FDC protocol.

feePercentageUpdateOffset.description: Fee percentage update timelock measured in reward epochs (must be more than 1, e.g. 3).

feedDecimalsList.description: The feed decimals used in the FTSO system.

firstRewardEpochStartVotingRoundId.description: The start voting round id of the first reward epoch.

firstVotingRoundStartTs.description: Timestamp of the first voting round start (in seconds since Unix epoch).

flareDaemonizedContracts.description: Flare daemonized contracts. Order matters. Inflation should be first.

ftsoInflationConfigurations.description: The inflation configurations for the FTSO protocol.

ftsoProtocolId.description: The FTSO protocol id - used for random number generation.

genesisGovernancePrivateKey.description:
Genesis governance private key (the key used as governance during deploy).
Overriden if set in `.env` file as `GENESIS_GOVERNANCE_PRIVATE_KEY`.

governanceExecutorPublicKey.description:
The public key of the executor (the account that is allowed to execute governance operations once the timelock expires).
Overriden if provided in `.env` file as `GOVERNANCE_EXECUTOR_PUBLIC_KEY`.

governancePrivateKey.description:
Governance private key (the private part of `governancePublicKey`).
Overriden if provided in `.env` file as `GOVERNANCE_PRIVATE_KEY`.
Note: this is only used in test deploys. In production, governance is a multisig address and there is no private key.

governancePublicKey.description:
Governance public key (the key to which governance is transferred after deploy).
Overriden if provided in `.env` file as `GOVERNANCE_PUBLIC_KEY`.

governanceTimelock.description:
The timelock in seconds to use for all governance operations (the time that has to pass before any governance operation is executed).
It safeguards the system against bad governance decisions or hijacked governance.

incentiveOfferDurationBlocks.description: The incentive offer duration in blocks.

initialNormalisedWeights.description: Normalised weights (sum < 2^16) of the voters used in the initial reward epoch id.

initialRandomVotePowerBlockSelectionSize.description: The initial random vote power block selection size in blocks (e.g. 1000).

initialRewardEpochOffset.description: The initial offset in reward epochs.

initialThreshold.description: Threshold used in the initial reward epoch id - should be less then the sum of the normalised weights.

initialVoterData.description: The initial voter data to be set in entity manager.

initialVoters.description: Voters used in the initial reward epoch id.

maintainer.description: Address of maintainer of PollingManagementGroup contract.

majorityConditionBIPS.description: Majority condition (in BIPS) for proposal to be accepted. If less than majorityConditionBIPS votes in favor, proposal can't be accepted.

maxNodeIdsPerEntity.description: Max number of nodes per entity (e.g. 4).

maxVotersPerRewardEpoch.description: Max number of voters per reward epoch (e.g. 100).

messageFinalizationWindowInRewardEpochs.description:
If reward epoch of a message is less then `lastInitializedRewardEpoch - messageFinalizationWindowInRewardEpochs`
the relaying of a message is not allowed.

minFeeBIPS.description: Minimum fee percentage value voters can set, in BIPS (e.g. 20%).

minimalRewardsOfferValueNAT.description: The minimal reward offer value in NAT (e.g. 1,000,000).

newSigningPolicyInitializationStartSecon.description: The time in seconds before the end of the reward epoch when the new signing policy initialization starts (e.g. 2 hours).

newSigningPolicyMinNumberOfVotingRoundsD.description: The minimal number of voting rounds delay for switching to the new signing policy (e.g. 3).

pChainStakeEnabled.description: Indicates whether the P-chain stake is enabled.

pChainStakeMirrorMaxAmountNAT.description: Max amount of P-chain stake. In whole native units, not Wei. Recommended value 200.000.000.

pChainStakeMirrorMaxDurationDays.description: Max duration of P-chain stake in days, recommended value 365 days

pChainStakeMirrorMinAmountNAT.description: Min amount of P-chain stake. In whole native units, not Wei. Recommended value 50.000.

pChainStakeMirrorMinDurationDays.description: Min duration of P-chain stake in days, recommended value 14 days

proposalFeeValueNAT.description: Cost of creating proposal (in NAT). It is paid by the proposer.

proposers.description: Array of proposers that can create a proposal

rNatFirstMonthStartTs.description: The RNat first month start timestamp.

rNatFundedByIncentivePool.description: Indicates if RNat is funded by incentive pool.

randomAcquisitionMaxDurationBlocks.description: The maximal random acquisition duration in blocks (e.g. 15000 blocks).

randomAcquisitionMaxDurationSeconds.description: The maximal random acquisition duration in seconds (e.g. 8 hour).

rangeIncreasePriceNAT.description: The range increase price. In whole native units, not Wei.

relayThresholdIncreaseBIPS.description: The increase of the threshold in BIPS for relaying the merkle root with the old signing policy (must be more than 100%).

removeAfterEligibleProposals.description: Number of last relevant proposals to check for not voting. Proposal is relevant if quorum was achieved and voting has ended.

removeAfterNonParticipatingProposals.description: In how many of removeAfterEligibleProposals proposals should data provider not participate (vote) in order to be eligible for removal from the management group.

removeAfterNotRewardedEpochs.description: Number of last epochs with initialised rewards in which data provider should not earn rewards in order to be eligible for removal from the management group.

removeForDays.description: Number of days for which member is removed from the management group.

rewardEpochDurationInVotingEpochs.description: The duration of a reward epoch in voting epochs.

rewardExpiryOffsetSeconds.description: The reward expiry offset in seconds (e.g. 90 days).

rewardManagerId.description: The reward manager id is used to identify the reward manager contract in the Flare Systems Manager contract (e.g. chain id).

sampleSizeIncreasePriceWei.description: The sample size increase price. In Wei.

signingPolicyMinNumberOfVoters.description: The minimal number of voters for the signing policy (e.g. 10).

signingPolicySignNoRewardsDurationBlocks.description: Number of blocks for new signing policy sign phase (in addition to non-punishable blocks) after which all rewards are burned (e.g. 600 blocks).

signingPolicySignNonPunishableDurationBl.description: The non-punishable new signing policy sign phase duration in blocks (e.g. 600 blocks).

signingPolicySignNonPunishableDurationSe.description: The non-punishable new signing policy sign phase duration in seconds (e.g. 20 minutes).

signingPolicyThresholdPPM.description: The threshold for the signing policy in PPM (must be less then 100%, e.g. 50%).

stakingFactor.description: Multiplier applied to node staking weights when computing voter registration weight (e.g. 5).

submissionDeployerPrivateKey.description: Submission deployer private key. Overriden if provided in `.env` file as `SUBMISSION_DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY`

submitUptimeVoteMinDurationBlocks.description: The minimal duration of uptime vote submission phase in blocks (e.g. 300 blocks).

submitUptimeVoteMinDurationSeconds.description: The minimal duration of uptime vote submission phase in seconds (e.g. 10 minutes).

teeAvailabilityCheckValidityDurationSeco.description:
The TEE availability check validity duration, in seconds (e.g. 1 day).
In order to receive rewards, TEE must be checked for availability at least once in this period.

teeChallengeValidityDurationSeconds.description: The TEE challenge validity duration (used for TEE availability check), in seconds (e.g. 30 minutes).

teeDefaultFeeWei.description: The default fee for TEE operations. In Wei.

teeEmergencyUnpauseGracePeriodSeconds.description:
Grace period (in seconds) applied after each per-extension emergency unpause.
While this window is open, the third-party expired-availability branch of
IMachineManager.pause() is blocked, so machine owners have time to refresh
their availability attestation without anyone immediately suspending their
still-PRODUCTION machines. Must be in [30 min (1800s), 24h (86400s)] on-chain.

teeOracleExtensionId.description:
The reserved TEE extension id serving the TEE oracle feeds. Minted by governance via
`IExtensionManager.registerReserved`.

teeOracleFeeDestinationAddress.description:
The destination address the TEE oracle feed stores forward collected read fees to.
Matches FastUpdater's live fee destination (the burn address) on all networks.

teeOracleFeeds.description:
The TEE oracle feeds. One `TeeOracleFeedStore` is deployed per entry, all served by
a single `TeeOracleInstructionsSender` on `teeOracleExtensionId` — one machine fleet
can serve multiple oracles.

teeOwnersPPM.description: The amount of rewards that are distributed to TEE owners, in PPM (e.g. 10%).

teePublicExtensionCreationEnabled.description:
If true, anyone can call IExtensionManager.register() from day 1 (the global
extension-owner allowlist starts in "allow all" mode). If false, registration
is closed at deploy time and governance must seed / open the allowlist later.
Reserved-id minting via registerReserved() is always governance-only and is
unaffected by this flag.

teeSigningPolicyValidityDurationInReward.description:
The signing policy validity duration, in reward epochs (e.g. 10).
Used when extending availability or putting tee machine into production:
- in case of registration, the check is done for the initial signing policy,
- in other cases, the check is done for the last confirmed signing policy.

teeSupportedKeyTypesWithSigningAlgos.description: List of supported TEE key types and signing algorithms

testDeployment.description: Indicates whether this is a test deployment (local, scdev, etc.)

thresholdConditionBIPS.description: Threshold (in BIPS) for proposal to potentially be accepted. If less than thresholdConditionBIPS of total vote power participates in vote, proposal can't be accepted.

voterRegistrationMinDurationBlocks.description: The minimal duration of voter registration phase in blocks (e.g. 900 blocks).

voterRegistrationMinDurationSeconds.description: The minimal duration of voter registration phase in seconds (e.g. 30 minutes).

votingDelaySeconds.description: Period (in seconds) between creation of proposal and voting start time.

votingEpochDurationSeconds.description: The duration of a voting epoch in seconds.

wNatCapPPM.description: The WNat cap used in signing policy weight, in PPM (e.g. 2.5%).
